scope.description: Exact published Marconi Technologies refresh lead covering Hunter variants, modem integration, predecessor maturity, legal identity, current partnership activity and the evidence limits around Canada's polar SATCOM terminal choice.

source.title: Hunter FA-180 Datasheet May 2026
source.locator: FA-180 configuration, setup, transport, feeds, environment, wind and optional motorization
source.summary: The FA-180 sheet describes a 1.8 metre eight-petal flyaway antenna, tool-free assembly in under ten minutes, quick-release C/X/Ku/Ka feeds and optional three-axis motorization; it does not establish Lightspeed compatibility.

leads.evidenceLocator: Hunter FA-180 sheet and family placemat, iDirect integration Q&A, Mercury Global sources, ESCP-P award and terminal-risk records, corporate registry and current partner announcement
followUpQuestions: Which Hunter variant is qualified for each target network, waveform and orbital regime under consideration?
What tracking, handover, Doppler and software evidence supports the proposed Hunter configuration for LEO service?
Which Mercury Global terminal variants map to today's Hunter family, and what current support responsibility remains with Marconi?
What configuration-specific production capacity, environmental qualification, delivery lead time and accepted-use evidence can be shared?
reviewWarnings: The supplied LinkedIn Pulse article is retained as discovery provenance and market positioning; it does not establish a Marconi ESCP-P award, Lightspeed compatibility or Canadian Armed Forces terminal selection.
Canada's official ESCP-P record names Telesat for the LEO service component and a future MDA Space and Telesat MEO arrangement; Marconi and Hunter are not named.
Shared Ka-band support or family-level multi-orbit positioning does not establish Lightspeed compatibility, LEO tracking and handover, modem-interface compliance or type certification.

Mercury Global records establish predecessor-business terminal delivery and program milestones but do not identify which current Hunter variants were fielded or Marconi's current support responsibility.
The Base Camp Connect relationship establishes an integration partnership and planned joint activity, not a CAF requirement, contract, delivery, acceptance or fielding.

ST Engineering iDirect supports a real technology-integration relationship, but the public article does not identify modem models, current LEO availability, customer deployments, certifications or independent test results.
The official Hunter family materials report variant-specific setup times; the prior family-wide under-five-minute statement applies only to ULV and is corrected in this proposal.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official site resolved the current portfolio, locations, public contact and Hunter family positioning without disclosing production capacity.
The FA-180 sheet resolved configuration, feed, setup and environmental details while adding no Lightspeed compatibility or certification evidence.
The federal registry resolved legal identity and significant-control ranges without an exact cap table or citizenship basis.
The pending trademark record tied the Marconi brand and claimed goods to Ultra Electronics TCS Inc. but did not prove registration, sales or performance.
Canada's ESCP-P record named Telesat and MDA Space with Telesat, and found no Marconi or Hunter award.
DND resolved predecessor Mercury Global terminal milestones without mapping them to current Hunter variants or support responsibility.
iDirect resolved the current modem-integration relationship and orbit evolution path while leaving modem models, LEO service and certification unresolved.
Base Camp Connect resolved a dated integration partnership and planned activity but no CAF procurement or fielding.
Independent reporting supported the transaction context but relied on interviews for employee, revenue and customer details, which were not promoted as canonical facts.
The French-language sweep added no safer field beyond the federal registry and durable current product, partner and government sources.

leads.refreshSummary: Marconi Technologies is proposed to correct and deepen the existing Hunter Tactical SATCOM Terminals capability, add current integration relationships, fill legal_name and ownership, and make the terminal-qualification decision boundary explicit.
intendedChanges: Set the current legal identity, federal ownership ranges, dated activity, defence posture, executive relevance summary and four specific reviewed questions.
Update the single existing Hunter capability with exact variants, setup times, current integration evidence, predecessor maturity and Lightspeed or ESCP-P limits.
Add Base Camp Connect and ST Engineering iDirect as bounded integration relationships without creating a Mission Area, Public Need, award or deployment claim.
